reference_mean_definition: Row mean of encoded feature values across all 699 reference cases, as in the author panel-classification notebooks; not binary event prevalence.
coverage_assumption: User approved provisional assumption on 2026-10-11: all profiled cases measured with BLYMFv2. Per-case panel and callability remain unverified.
reduction: Linear weights derived from official construct_reduced_winning_version applied to an identity basis. Numerically equivalent for integral inputs; preserves fractional means that the original astype(int) truncates.
mutation_encoding: Existing selected nonsilent mutation calls recoded 1 to 2; existing 2 retained. No new variants selected.
cnv: Regional CN features unavailable; gene-only discovery CN calls cannot determine regional calls.
fish: Final translocation table: measured 0/1 -> GSM 0/3; missing -> reference mean.
